lines: A 5-year period estimate covering 2019 to 2023. It describes the whole window, not any single year in it, and must not be relabelled with one year.
This build does not check whether the provider has published a newer release; it reports what was retrieved.
Places are compared with each other inside one reference period, which needs no boundary equivalence.
This brief reports a single area with no reference value, so nothing is being compared.
This brief reports a single area, read against New York City (all five boroughs). Both come from the same reference period, so no boundary equivalence is needed.
This brief reports a single area. The reference that was requested could not be built, so nothing is compared here.

uncertainty_templates.published: {usable} of {total} selected areas have a published estimate
uncertainty_templates.published_missing: ; {missing} do not and are shown as 'no data'.
uncertainty_templates.no_moe: {n} have no usable margin of error. Missing uncertainty is unavailable, not zero.
uncertainty_templates.high_cv: {n} area(s) have a high relative error (coefficient of variation of 30% or more). Treat those single values as indicative rather than precise.
uncertainty_templates.widest: The widest margin of error among the selected areas is ±{widest} percentage points at 90% confidence.
uncertainty_templates.none_usable: Every selected area's estimate is unavailable. The reason for each is in the table and the exported data.
